items.title: Dollar Stores In Earnings Spotlight, With 2 Stocks In Buy Zones
items.summary: Dollar Tree earnings and Dollar General earnings are on deck Thursday, with Five Below due next week. On Wednesday, DLTR stock and FIVE stock rose in buy zones. Early Thursday, Dollar Tree and Dollar General will report for the fiscal second quarter.

items.title: Dollar General vs. Dollar Tree: Which Stock Is the Better Buy Before Q2 Earnings?
items.summary: Both discount retailers are expected to post solid growth, but their valuation, stock performance, and shareholder-return profiles offer investors two different setups heading into Q2 earnings.

items.title: DICK'S Sporting Shares Plunge 31% on Soft Q2 Earnings & Lower View
items.summary: DKS misses Q2 earnings estimates as Foot Locker weakness, promotional pressure and higher costs force a sharp cut to its fiscal 2026 outlook.

items.title: KSS Q2 Earnings Beat Estimates on Margin Gains, Outlook Raised
items.summary: KSS posts second-quarter adjusted EPS of $1.28, more than doubling year over year, as gross margin expands and fiscal 2026 earnings guidance is increased.

items.title: Target (TGT) Q2 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
items.summary: Digital comparable sales jumped 8.7%, led by same-day delivery growth.
